title: URGENT: SCADA RTU Communication Failure at 400kV Jaipur Substation
description:
Dear IT Support Team,

We are experiencing a critical SCADA communication failure at our 400kV
Jaipur substation (RTU ID: JAI-NR-RTU-042) that has persisted for the last
3 hours.

PROBLEM DETAILS:
- Error Code: ERR-RTU-001 displaying on RLDC master console
- Last successful poll: Today at 11:45 AM
- Current Status: "RTU NOT RESPONDING" with timeout errors
- Impact: Unable to monitor real-time power flow on 220kV Jaipur-Ajmer
transmission line

We have already tried basic troubleshooting:
1. Verified physical fiber optic cable - No breaks detected
2. Pinged RTU IP address 172.16.10.142 - Getting timeouts >5000ms
3. Checked local RTU cabinet - All LEDs showing green status
4. Rebooted RTU twice - Problem persists

Additional observations:
- IEC 60870-5-104 protocol seems to be failing
- STARTDT frame not receiving STARTDT_CON response
- Firewall logs show packets reaching the RTU but no response
- Other RTUs in the same region (Ajmer, Bikaner) are working fine

This is affecting our Grid Operations as we cannot see:
- Generator MW output from Jaipur Thermal Station
- Voltage levels at 400kV bus
- Circuit breaker status for 8 critical feeders
